'''2004 Origins''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Columbus, Ohio. Origins 2004 ran 24–27 June 2004; the Players Committee's Origins 2004 DPC Championship was played on Saturday 26 June at the Greater Columbus Convention Center: eight games of Swiss and a playoff between the top 4, with two Day 2 byes to the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-origins04">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603161554/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2004/origins2004.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Origins 2004], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 June 2004.</ref> The DPC Championship was put together by the Players Committee and [[DeckTech|Decktech, Inc.]]; it started at 10am, cost $20 to enter, and paid cash to the champion and to the 2nd-, 3rd- and 4th-place finishers.<ref name="pc-origins04" /> About 30 players took part. In the semifinals [[Reid Smith]] (CCT) beat [[Greg Shaw]] (Hidden Base) and [[Brian Hunter]] (Hunt Down) beat [[Drew Scott]] (Watch Your Step); Hunter and Reid Smith split the prize money and Hunter was named champion, and Shaw beat Scott for 3rd and the other bye, according to a player's post on the PC forums.<ref name="pcf-3531">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531&amp Origins Report?] (29 June 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 13 July 2004.</ref> Earlier wiki text dated the event July 2004 from its DeckTech decklist. Decklists below were recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 24–27 June 2004 (DPC Championship 26 June)<ref name="pc-origins04" />
* '''Venue:''' Greater Columbus Convention Center<ref name="pc-origins04" />
* '''Players:''' about 30<ref name="pcf-3531" />

Results as posted on the PC forums by a player who took part.<ref name="pcf-3531" /> [[Kyle Krueger]] finished 4–2 and missed the top 4 on differential.<ref name="pcf-3531" /> Hunter played [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] and [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], the same decks he had used at the DPC in Normal; Reid Smith played a CCT space deck; Shaw played Walkers and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] with spies; and Scott played Hunt Down and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]. Reid Smith's and Shaw's only Swiss losses were to Hunter, Shaw had one timed win, and Scott lost to Shaw and, the poster believed, to [[Justin Stratton]].<ref name="pcf-3531" /> Krueger played [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]], having left part of the deck he meant to play at home.<ref name="pcf-3531-48338">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48338#48338 Origins Report?], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Stratton played Watto.<ref name="pcf-3531-48302">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48302#48302 Origins Report?], Justin Stratton, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

On the Dark Side most players used Dark Deal and Hunt Down decks; [[Bill Kafer]] and Shaw played the only two Walkers decks the poster saw, and CCT, Bring Him Before Me and Watto decks also appeared. On the Light Side most played [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], Hidden Base and Throne Room Mains, with occasional Speeders, Watch Your Step and [[Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|Massassi Base Operations]] decks.<ref name="pcf-3531" /> [[Royce Russell]], who was working the Decipher booth, saw about 30 players in the game room on Saturday and the prizes handed out at about 6pm.<ref name="pcf-3531-48280">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48280#48280 Origins Report?], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Side events ==

The Players Committee's other events at Origins 2004 were a [[Secret Squirrel]] sealed-deck tournament (Thursday 24 June, 6pm, $10, foils and boosters for all), a constructed tournament in the [[Classic]] format (Friday 25 June, 6pm, $5, foils, boosters and an uncut sheet) and the Origins Team Tournament (Sunday 27 June, 11am, $25 per team, uncut sheets for the winning team). Players who wanted more events were asked to email Tournament Support Advocate [[Mitch Velasco]] before 10 June 2004.<ref name="pc-origins04" />
